motivation: C4 recovered 0.95% of the oracle gap and C6 showed that anchor-failure prediction is not action aligned
quality_target: per-task per-model mean quality over three frozen repeats; continuous rather than winner class
quality_predictor: fold-local word+character TF-IDF Ridge; one shared query representation with five model outputs
decision_layer: predicted quality plus fold-local model cost, latency, and reliability profiles; no cost or latency in the quality loss
catastrophic_risk_estimator: training-only Beta-smoothed empirical probability for each anchor-to-candidate action
outer_cv: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260831) over unique tasks
bootstrap_unit: task with all models and repeats paired
pass_action: freeze implementation and preregister a new untouched v4 confirmation
fail_action: report the failure; do not tune thresholds or use v3 for model selection
